snippet.title: The Drylands | Official Car RPG Trailer
snippet.description:
An upcoming car party-based RPG. 

Create the perfect team and car to speed through The Drylands, fighting for loot and completing quests in an ever-changing procedurally generated world as the shifting sands reveal lost secrets

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2827720/The_Drylands/
